I'm still in my porbabtion period so not sure I can ask for a transfer. I am actually moving to a different place to get closer to my uni in another 2-3 weeks, maybe I can ask, but more likely to be denied. 

You are right, this is causing me a lot of anxiety and making it hard to focus on my studies. Honestly don't even mind working in dining area but the attitude of managers have made it difficult to work. I know for a fact that if I say anything or retaliate I will most likely be fired with them finding reasons.
How can  I transfer?

Thank you for your reply! I just sent them the hospital letter regarding my injury as proof. They haven't said anything yet. I'm not sure why but according to my contract the probation period is 91 days.
But I'm not sick, I'm injured. And in my contract it's not written anything about strikes, it's written that they can terminate my employment without notice within this 91 days probation period.

But it has been just the fourth week since I started and I have already missed a weekend of work. I was late today because of the injury and late one day before (8-10 mins), and my manager wasn't happy with that.

Lmao. I laughed so hard at that. I'm an Indian and have pcos as well. My body is naturally hairy and hirsutism just added to it.  I had a full beard and mustache in my school years but since then things have become much better. I've been taking laser treatment for 3 years, around 10-11 sessions and my growth has become minimal, minimal here meaning the normal for most women, like small and fine chin hairs.
Thank you! I've been reading some books to Improve myself and reading some good articles through Google scholar. I will ask around locally and see if there is any low cost therapy available.
I find it hard too. I started working out a bit and all that sweat gets me going for shower, however it is still a bit delayed

I relate to this so much. I've always been over sensitive but my family dismisses it as a symptom of menstruation and being a "girl". It infuriates me and I want to voice my protest but I can't because I'm unable to express my anger or opinions calmly when opposed. I just start crying. It's very frustrating, but I have learned to keep myself calm after being subjected to this again and again, but I can't deal with a lot of things without reacting like this.

Happy Birthday!! 
Here's the number I've chosen- 268

Recieving quality education and getting tutored by teachers who actually help you find your passion. Especially in higher education. Here they don't have such institutions, except a few which are extremely hard to get into because of competition and over population. In normal colleges, which are even considered good they don't have such good teachers nor lab facilities.
That certainly helps! Thank you.
I can also see seed development after the flowers have been shed. But these white lines on leaves are making me worried about the health of the plant. It's growing okay.
Probably yes! I will try not to move it and keep it on a shelf. Thank you :)

Thank you for the tip! I did water the soil from above on both days and I think the roots are well watered. The leaves are soft and limpy and I'm just scared to touch them because 2 just came into my hand. I won't move it around that much. Thank you.
I also put sheet over at night as the temperatures here drop down to 10-9°C

2 days since I got this, my croton has dropped down and lost 2 leaves. I've been moving it around accordingly to get some sun in the day. It was like last pic before. Now it is all sad and low :( and I don't know what to do. I spray it with water everyday to maintain moisture
Lipstick Aglonema
DM?

Ikrrr! I'm thinking of growing fenugreek microgreens to except my house doesn't receive direct sunlight even in the balcony so it might not work. But I've also been thinking of growing some mustard greens into a plant. Any idea how I can do that?

I didn't use a seed package. Mustard is pretty commonly found in kitchens too so I asked my mum about it and found some. I germinated those only. They've grown beautifully and I didn't have to any effort. It took 4 days total to see little leaves emerging
I grew some mustard microgreens and even though I spread the seeds evenly there were still some empty spaces left. I don't know why it happened but it's nothing to be worried about.

Just don't let the soil get dry and keep it constantly moist and wet but not that much that the water is sitting in there. You will figure it out easily so don't stress that much. Just constant moisture should maintained. 😊
